sql: select retail_l_region as k,sum(retail_f_amount)::bigint as v from retail_fact join retail_entity on retail_f_entity=retail_e_id join retail_label on retail_e_label=retail_l_id where retail_f_id between 101 and 1000 and retail_f_day between 30 and 330 group by retail_l_region order by k
oracle_sql: with b as(select (select retail_l_region from retail_label where retail_l_id=(select retail_e_label from retail_entity where retail_e_id=retail_f_entity)) as k,retail_f_amount as v from retail_fact where retail_f_id between 101 and 1000 and retail_f_day between 30 and 330) select k,sum(v)::bigint as v from b group by k order by k
adaptation: Conceptual structural adaptation only. Replaces sales/date/item dimensions with fact/entity/label, changes filters and grouping, and bounds the input range. Not canonical TPC-DS Q3; no TPC data generator used.

sql: select billing_f_channel as k,count(*) as v from billing_fact f where billing_f_id between 101 and 1000 and billing_f_amount>1.2*(select avg(j.billing_f_amount) from billing_fact j where j.billing_f_channel=f.billing_f_channel and j.billing_f_id between 101 and 1000) group by billing_f_channel having count(*)>=10 order by k
oracle_sql: with b as(select billing_f_channel as k,billing_f_amount as v from billing_fact where billing_f_id between 101 and 1000),a as(select k,avg(v) as threshold from b group by k) select b.k,count(*) as v from b join a on b.k=a.k where b.v>1.2*a.threshold group by b.k having count(*)>=10 order by b.k
adaptation: Conceptual adaptation of the correlated 1.2-times-category-average predicate and grouped count. Original five-table schema and date filters are not retained. Not canonical TPC-DS Q6, not an independent enterprise task corpus.
